palindrome:
A palindrome is a word, phrase, number, or other sequence of characters which reads the same backward as forward. Here's an example of a palindrome that is more than 360 characters:

```
Able was I ere I saw Elba.
Step on no pets.
Was it a car or a cat I saw?
No 'x' in Nixon.
Level madam level
Racecar
Madam, in Eden, I'm Adam.
```

Note: A palindrome can be created from any text input by repeating the input and appending its reverse to itself.
